episodes.synopsis: New student Oliver arrives at Kimberly Magic Academy, a house of learning where 20% of the students don't make it out in one piece.
episodes.title: Ceremony

episodes.synopsis: The new students settle into life at Kimberly, and Oliver has an intense duel with Nanao.
episodes.title: Sword Arts

episodes.synopsis: The new students find themselves trapped in Kimberly at night, with two powerful upperclassmen out to recruit them dead or alive.
episodes.title: Soldier

episodes.synopsis: After Katie is bullied by the other students, her friends end up in a classroom brawl. But that won't be the only fight they see...
episodes.title: Colosseum

episodes.synopsis: Nanao and Oliver face down a powerful foe who has designs on Katie.
episodes.title: Glare

episodes.synopsis: Oliver and Nanao battle a powerful mage with an enchanted eye, and the true purpose of Oliver's coming to Kimberly is revealed.
episodes.title: Arise

episodes.synopsis: Oliver and friends attend their first broomriding class. Meanwhile, Pete discovers something unexpected about himself.
episodes.title: Reversi

episodes.synopsis: Another student challenges Oliver and his friends to see who's really the strongest of their grade.
episodes.title: Rivals

episodes.synopsis: Katie is given a workshop, and she and her friends go into the labyrinth to take a look at it.
episodes.title: Explore

episodes.synopsis: Oliver and his friends are caught in a brutal team battle against other students deep within the labyrinth.
episodes.title: Master and Knight

episodes.synopsis: Oliver and Chela fight a duel deep in the labyrinth, against an opponent who will do anything to avoid defeat.
episodes.title: Duty

episodes.synopsis: Oliver and Chela recruit an unexpected ally to help them venture into the labyrinth and get back Pete.
episodes.title: Possibility

episodes.synopsis: Nanao, Oliver, and Chela venture through the labyrinth, encountering strange creatures and deadly threats.
episodes.title: Noisy Forest

episodes.synopsis: As everyone heads deeper beneath the academy, Godfrey and Carlos think back to Ophelia's past.
episodes.title: Salvadori

episodes.synopsis: Ophelia's plan reaches its climax, trapping Oliver and his friends inside another world where she rules.
episodes.title: Last Song
